# IK ENG

> IK ENG Ltd is a Manchester-based China sourcing agent (125 Great Clowes Street, Salford M7 1AL; Companies House no. 17044943, incorporated February 2026). It sources kitchens, wardrobes, furniture, full FF&E packages, lighting, acoustic panels, saunas, aluminium pergolas and building materials from Chinese factories for UK homeowners, interior designers, property developers and HMO landlords, and manages inspection, shipping, customs and delivery to UK sites. Founder Sai Jyothis is the UK point of contact and brings 20+ years of factory relationships across Guangzhou, Shenzhen and Foshan.

Key facts:

- Sourcing fee: 3–5% of product value, depending on order size, shown on every quotation. Inspection, samples and delivery are listed separately.
- Payment terms: 50% deposit to place the order, the 50% balance after our pre-shipment inspection (photos and video of your finished, packed goods), before loading; shipping, duty and VAT are invoiced separately.
- Lead times: standard items typically 10-12 weeks to site; bespoke items 12-18 weeks from approved drawings.
- First factory options and pricing within 48 hours of a complete brief.
- No container minimum to enquire; single homes and small orders are welcome.
- Compliance: BS 7177 for mattresses and beds, permanent fire labels on relevant upholstered furniture, and conformity documents for electrical goods.
- Design and specification: an in-house designer prepares room layouts, mood boards and product schedules for a fixed fee agreed in advance, credited against the order.
- Contact: sai@ikeng.co.uk, +44 7767 990007 (phone and WhatsApp).
